main_subject.detail: A fact-style social post with a red tag '# TOYOTA SERIES' and the large question 'BAN CO BIET ?'. The main statement says 'Vios la mot trong nhung mau xe "quoc dan" tai Viet Nam'. A white Toyota Vios sedan drives on an open road under a blue sky. Bottom statistics read 'CAN MOC 250.000+ XE' and 'DAI LY 80+ PHAN PHOI CA NUOC'. Bottom-right script says 'Move your world'. Toyota logo is top right.
